name: Paired Dynamic Response Mediation
dominant_bottleneck: post-intervention paired dynamic response / outcome-process sufficiency for effectful selected outcome order
mechanism_hypothesis: Planned proposal-vs-incumbent geometry is only a proxy for the realized treatment. If effectful outcome order is mediated by the actual closed-loop response induced over the one-shot operator-exposure window, a paired realized treatment-control state transition should identify final paired outcome order more stably than the strongest V53 pre-execution temporal state.

state_collection.population: exact frozen 502 V50/V51/V52/V53 full-set RSMR proposals
state_collection.window: from exact one-shot intervention anchor through the first scheduled planner replan
state_collection.synchronization: exact simulation iteration index and timestamp across treatment/control
state_collection.state: simulated ego rear-axle x/y/yaw and speed at every tick in the exposure window
state_collection.coordinate_frame: paired treatment-control position delta rotated into shared t0 control ego frame
state_collection.terminal_sample_optimization: At the first scheduled replan index, record the pre-replan state and return the cached trajectory without executing a second expensive BDSE replan; simulation terminates immediately after.

realized_endpoint.question: Is the realized one-replan state transition the missing mediator beyond planned operator geometry?

realized_temporal.state: realized_endpoint plus fixed DCT-II k=1,2 of paired realized dx/dy/dyaw/dv over the operator-exposure window
realized_temporal.question: If realized endpoint is insufficient, is realized response shape necessary?

retrospective_oracle.purpose: diagnostic only: test whether the post-intervention mediator plus frozen V52 support could satisfy the historical paired gate if it were available

runtime_claim_boundary.allowed_claim_if_identified: realized paired response is an outcome mediator
runtime_claim_boundary.forbidden_claim: V54 itself is a deployable pre-action retention mechanism

next_branches.if_realized_endpoint_identified: Freeze minimal realized transition mediator. Next version must make it deployable by predicting it from runtime-available pre-execution state or by defining an auditable continuation operator; do not use future state at t0.
next_branches.if_only_realized_temporal_identified: Freeze realized temporal mediator and design a deployable temporal mediator prediction/continuation test without basis/horizon tuning.
next_branches.if_identified_but_retrospective_oracle_g: Dynamic state carries signal but static sign functional remains insufficient; next solve a structured paired dynamic outcome functional before more state expansion.
next_branches.if_both_fail: Close short-horizon realized ego-response state as sufficient; next paired evidence must represent realized interaction/safety consequence process, not more ego trajectory geometry.

prohibited: using post-intervention state directly as t0 runtime input
resurrecting V46 predicted occupancy temporal profile
untouched validation before a deployable mechanism exists
